Application Data.NAME: Smith Trophy & Awards Shop
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith Trophy & Awards Shop specializes in the design, manufacturing, and retail of custom trophies, awards, and plaques for various events, including sports competitions, corporate recognition, and academic achievements. Our shop has been in continuous operation for over five years, located in a well-trafficked area that attracts a diverse clientele. We prioritize exceptional customer service and have implemented robust inventory controls, including CCTV security systems and regular employee training focused on loss prevention. Additionally, we maintain a strong online presence, allowing customers to place orders through our e-commerce platform while ensuring secure shipping practices. Our commitment to quality is reflected in our formalized quality control processes, which aim to uphold product integrity and minimize liability exposures associated with our offerings.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a theft incident occurred at the Smith Trophy & Awards Shop, resulting in the loss of inventory valued at $2,500. The cause was determined to be a break-in during after-hours, and the business filed a police report. The case is currently under investigation, but no suspects have been identified. The business has implemented additional security measures, including enhanced alarm systems and increased surveillance, to prevent future occurrences.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: CCTV surveillance system, monitored alarm system, and regular employee training on theft prevention.
